final: WITH oc AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), avg_all AS (SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order") AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS a), kept AS (SELECT oc.account_id, oc.cnt FROM oc, avg_all WHERE oc.cnt > avg_all.a), avg_kept AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS k FROM kept) SELECT kept.account_id, kept.cnt AS order_count, kept.cnt - avg_all.a AS above_overall_avg, kept.cnt - avg_kept.k AS above_kept_avg FROM kept, avg_all, avg_kept ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC LIMIT 10
